title: .floop container format — v1 (frozen)
description: Byte-level definition of the .floop LoopPackage archive. Frozen so the digest gate (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §20/§28, FB-RAT-PKG-004) is testable. Extension '.floop' itself remains FB-RAT-LBX-010 (EXPERIMENTAL) pending owner naming/branding review (08_OPEN_QUESTIONS §E.3) — this registry freezes the BYTES, not the final public-facing extension string.

prohibitedCompressionMethods: any method not STORED or DEFLATE
archiveFormat.directoryEntries: PROHIBITED — every archive member is a file entry; empty directories are not representable and MUST NOT be encoded as zero-length directory entries
archiveFormat.extraFields: PROHIBITED — local file header and central directory extra-field areas MUST be empty; a reader MUST reject an archive carrying non-empty extra fields
archiveFormat.entrySortOrder: Archive members MUST be written in ascending order of their normalized path, compared as UTF-16 code units — this is a WRITE requirement for reproducibility, not a read-time trust requirement (a reader still normalizes and sorts its own view)
archiveFormat.symlinks: PROHIBITED — an entry whose external file attributes encode a symlink (or any non-regular-file Unix mode) MUST be rejected
archiveFormat.localAndCentralDirectoryAgreement: A reader MUST reject an archive where any entry's local file header (size, CRC-32, compression method) disagrees with its central directory record — a classic ZIP-parser-confusion / zip-bomb vector
archiveFormat.notes: The ratio/total/count ceilings are calibratable (EXPERIMENTAL numeric parameters per the 08_OPEN_QUESTIONS §C pattern for numeric thresholds); the STRUCTURAL rules above them (no symlinks, no directory entries, no extra fields, local/central agreement) are normative and not calibratable.

pathRules.dotSegments: PROHIBITED — a normalized path MUST NOT contain a '.' or '..' segment
pathRules.caseSensitivity: paths are compared byte-for-byte after NFC normalization; case-insensitive collisions across entries (e.g. 'A.json' vs 'a.json') MUST be rejected as duplicate-normalized-path
pathRules.duplicateNormalizedPaths: PROHIBITED — two entries that normalize to the same path is a rejection, not a silent last-write-wins
adversarialClasses_MUST_reject: path traversal ('../' anywhere in the raw or normalized name)
unknown major schema version in manifest.json

requiredTopLevelLayout.manifest.json: REQUIRED — LoopPackage manifest: package identity (loopId, semanticVersion), capability requests, compatibility declaration, inventory (see packageInventory below), signature reference. schemaVersion-gated.
requiredTopLevelLayout.definition.json: REQUIRED — canonical LoopDefinition JSON (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §2.2/§3). SOLE source of semantic identity — see semantic-digest.v1.json. This is the file the digest gate is computed over (after exclusions + canonicalization).
requiredTopLevelLayout.definition.bpmn: OPTIONAL, DERIVED — a regenerable BPMN 2.0 export of definition.json for portability with generic BPMN tooling (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §13). EXCLUDED from both the package content digest and the signed file set (see packageInventory.semanticFiles vs .derivedFiles below) — a build MAY omit it and regenerate on demand; its presence or absence MUST NOT change the package digest.
requiredTopLevelLayout.schemas/: OPTIONAL — input/output/form JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12+) referenced by definition.json by relative path.
requiredTopLevelLayout.fixtures/: OPTIONAL — simulation/replay/fault-injection fixtures, keyed per fixture-keying.v1 (nodeId, iterationIndex, callIndex) — NOT 'tests/fixtures/'. This resolves the two conflicting layouts found in the source pack (10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM §B2).
requiredTopLevelLayout.docs/: OPTIONAL — human-readable documentation (README, objective, usage notes). Treated as untrusted content by the runtime (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §25) and subject to prompt-static-scanning + invisible-Unicode rejection like every other model-visible or human-visible string in the package.
requiredTopLevelLayout.assets/: OPTIONAL — non-executable static assets (icons, media) referenced by definition.json or docs/. MUST NOT contain any file matching the forbidden-executable-payload class (see loop-validation-rules.v1.json LOOP-PKG-002).
requiredTopLevelLayout.LICENSE: OPTIONAL — license text if the package declares one (feeds LOOP-LINEAGE-* checks).
requiredTopLevelLayout.signatures/: OPTIONAL — detached signature file(s), loop-package-signature.v1 (Ed25519 over contentDigest + release identity, per 10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM §D).

packageInventory.description: manifest.json MUST carry a per-file inventory. Every entry declares path, byteLength, sha256, and exactly one classification.

classifications.semanticFile: Included in the package content digest (definition.json, schemas/*, fixtures/*, docs/*, assets/*, LICENSE — everything except derivedFiles and signatures/).
classifications.derivedFile: Regenerable from semanticFiles; EXCLUDED from the package content digest. definition.bpmn is the canonical example. A derived file's own digest is still recorded in the inventory for integrity-on-extract, but it does not participate in identity.
classifications.signatureFile: Signature material under signatures/; excluded from the digest it signs, by construction.

packageContentDigest.computedOver: the CANONICAL FILE LIST, not raw archive bytes: a deterministically sorted sequence of (normalizedPath, byteLength, sha256OfFileBytes) tuples for every semanticFile, JCS-canonicalized as a JSON array and then SHA-256'd once more to produce the single packageContentDigest.
packageContentDigest.rationale: Computing over the file list rather than archive bytes makes identity invariant to recompression, ZIP tool, member order in the physical archive, and timestamp/OS metadata fields — none of which are semantic. This was ambiguous in the source pack ('RFC 8785-style... or a versioned equivalent') and is now pinned: no escape hatch. See semantic-digest.v1.json for the SEPARATE, narrower semanticDigest computed only over definition.json.
packageContentDigest.timestampFreedom: ZIP local-file-header mtime/date fields MUST NOT be read by any digest or compatibility computation — archive identity is timestamp-free by construction (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §28).
